lines.text: Mara says you're the company that found out who was selling Wayline's schedules.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [guarded, measuring] Mara says you're the company that found out who was selling Wayline's schedules.

lines.text: We were.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [even] We were.

lines.text: Then you'll understand why I'm careful what I say in front of Wayline's people.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [dry, guarded] Then you'll understand why I'm careful what I say in front of Wayline's people.

lines.text: We're not Wayline's people. We took their contract. Now we'd be taking yours.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [calm, direct] We're not Wayline's people. We took their contract. Now we'd be taking yours.

lines.text: We'll see. You've read the survey, so you've seen the valley. Here's the rest. Three cycles back, two fleets fought it out in low orbit over Asharu. A Colossus and a few of her escorts came down here. We were the first crew in. The claim's ours.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [unimpressed, then practical] We'll see. You've read the survey, so you've seen the valley. Here's the rest. Three cycles back, two fleets fought it out in low orbit over Asharu. A Colossus and a few of her escorts came down here. We were the first crew in. The claim's ours.

lines.text: Three cycles is a long time on one wreck.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious] Three cycles is a long time on one wreck.

lines.text: It's a Colossus. You don't strip one in a season. That fight dropped hulls from here to the southern flats, so every crew on Asharu had its own pickings and nobody bothered with us. Then word got round we'd found something.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [matter-of-fact, a little proud] It's a Colossus. You don't strip one in a season. That fight dropped hulls from here to the southern flats, so every crew on Asharu had its own pickings and nobody bothered with us. Then word got round we'd found something.

lines.text: Got round how?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [sharp] Got round how?

lines.text: When we opened the hold, I put in a fuel order with Wayline. Enough to lift something heavy off-world, and a camp like ours never needs that much. A few weeks later Dace Harlan's crew came in shooting at shift change.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [bitter, controlled] When we opened the hold, I put in a fuel order with Wayline. Enough to lift something heavy off-world, and a camp like ours never needs that much. A few weeks later Dace Harlan's crew came in shooting at shift change.

lines.text: That's about when Wayline's schedules were being sold.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, thoughtful] That's about when Wayline's schedules were being sold.

lines.text: You'd know better than I would. Or it was me, talking too loud in a Jangala bar. I can't prove either. We got most of our people out, and now the roaches are stripping our yard and telling anyone who'll listen it was abandoned.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [tired, angry underneath] You'd know better than I would. Or it was me, talking too loud in a Jangala bar. I can't prove either. We got most of our people out, and now the roaches are stripping our yard and telling anyone who'll listen it was abandoned.

lines.text: Most of your people.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [gentle, attentive] Most of your people.

lines.text: My cousin Jory's crew is still inside the Colossus, sealed in where the squatters haven't found a way through. They've kept a quiet channel open. That's how I know the yard's held, and roughly by how many.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [low, protective] My cousin Jory's crew is still inside the Colossus, sealed in where the squatters haven't found a way through. They've kept a quiet channel open. That's how I know the yard's held, and roughly by how many.

lines.text: This is Hegemony space. Is anyone else going to take an interest?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured] This is Hegemony space. Is anyone else going to take an interest?

lines.text: Our permit's on file at Jangala. The Hegemony doesn't send a patrol over two salvage crews squabbling in a ditch. It'd come quick enough if somebody gave it a reason. So we settle this ourselves, and quietly.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [dry, wary] Our permit's on file at Jangala. The Hegemony doesn't send a patrol over two salvage crews squabbling in a ditch. It'd come quick enough if somebody gave it a reason. So we settle this ourselves, and quietly.

lines.text: Then tell me where it ends. We're not going into your Colossus, and we're not chasing this outfit across Asharu.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [firm, businesslike] Then tell me where it ends. We're not going into your Colossus, and we're not chasing this outfit across Asharu.

lines.text: Good. I don't want you in her, and Jory's people will keep out of your way. You take the receiving store and the workshop; my militia follow you in and hold them. Then the service cradle.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [brisk] Good. I don't want you in her, and Jory's people will keep out of your way. You take the receiving store and the workshop; my militia follow you in and hold them. Then the service cradle.

lines.text: What's on the cradle?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious] What's on the cradle?

lines.text: A Shepherd. Another hull off that fight. Broke her back coming down; we hauled her in to cut up. Her reactor and drone bay are the best scrap in this yard outside the Colossus, and I had a buyer asking after that bay before any of this. Jory says they've had her panels off for a week.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical, valuing] A Shepherd. Another hull off that fight. Broke her back coming down; we hauled her in to cut up. Her reactor and drone bay are the best scrap in this yard outside the Colossus, and I had a buyer asking after that bay before any of this. Jory says they've had her panels off for a week.

lines.text: I want to know what they've taken. Two of my techs on her, with your rifles round them, long enough to find out. Cover them from her south side. Harlan's lot come and go along the south haul road. That's where they'll come back.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm, practical] I want to know what they've taken. Two of my techs on her, with your rifles round them, long enough to find out. Cover them from her south side. Harlan's lot come and go along the south haul road. That's where they'll come back.

lines.text: South haul checkpoint's taking fire. They're day hands, Captain, but they're my hire. Give them a hand if you can.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] South haul checkpoint's taking fire. They're day hands, Captain, but they're my hire. Give them a hand if you can.

lines.text: South haul checkpoint's running. Can't say I blame them, for what I'm paying. Cover them back to the inner line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [resigned, urgent] South haul checkpoint's running. Can't say I blame them, for what I'm paying. Cover them back to the inner line.

lines.text: South haul checkpoint's gone. So much for proper guards. Watch for anyone coming back, and keep that approach covered.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [bitter] South haul checkpoint's gone. So much for proper guards. Watch for anyone coming back, and keep that approach covered.

lines.text: The south haul hands have made the inner line. They're staying put, at least. Help them hold it.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [grudging relief] The south haul hands have made the inner line. They're staying put, at least. Help them hold it.

lines.text: Quarry checkpoint has contact. There's only three of them out there, Captain. Support them if you can.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] Quarry checkpoint has contact. There's only three of them out there, Captain. Support them if you can.

lines.text: Quarry checkpoint's falling back. Keep the crossing covered for them.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] Quarry checkpoint's falling back. Keep the crossing covered for them.

lines.text: The quarry checkpoint's gone. Keep the inner line covered. There may still be people coming in.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [grim] The quarry checkpoint's gone. Keep the inner line covered. There may still be people coming in.

lines.text: The quarry hands are in, on the inner line with my militia. Keep that ground covered.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [relieved] The quarry hands are in, on the inner line with my militia. Keep that ground covered.

lines.text: The new gun's covering the inner line. Keep the fitters working, Captain. We've bought them some room.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [relieved] The new gun's covering the inner line. Keep the fitters working, Captain. We've bought them some room.

lines.text: That party on the south haul road has broken off at your screen. Keep watching the entry.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: That party on the south haul road has broken off at your screen. Keep watching the entry.

lines.text: They've broken off at your quarry-road screen. Don't leave the entry open.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: They've broken off at your quarry-road screen. Don't leave the entry open.

lines.text: Pump bend clear. Bring Morrow up behind the company and build a road gun. Keep her builders covered, Captain.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm, practical] Pump bend clear. Bring Morrow up behind the company and build a road gun. Keep her builders covered, Captain.

lines.text: There's a gun at the pump bend now. Keep that position covered while you move through the narrows. The haulers will need this road behind you.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: There's a gun at the pump bend now. Keep that position covered while you move through the narrows. The haulers will need this road behind you.

lines.text: Narrows secured. Build the next gun before moving on, Captain. We need the southern approach covered.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm, practical] Narrows secured. Build the next gun before moving on, Captain. We need the southern approach covered.

lines.text: The position's ready. Keep the narrows covered and clear the eastern yard for her drive test. Give her room to leave.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [focused] The position's ready. Keep the narrows covered and clear the eastern yard for her drive test. Give her room to leave.

lines.text: She's in the eastern yard. Your crew are spooling her drives, and Teo's talking them through it. Stay with her, Captain; keep the approach clear.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [tense, hopeful] She's in the eastern yard. Your crew are spooling her drives, and Teo's talking them through it. Stay with her, Captain; keep the approach clear.

lines.text: Drive test complete. Morrow is climbing, Captain. Hold that approach until she's clear of the basin.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, focused] Drive test complete. Morrow is climbing, Captain. Hold that approach until she's clear of the basin.

lines.text: She's clear of the basin. Registry's yours, Captain. We hauled her in to cut her up. Look at her now.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [quiet wonder] She's clear of the basin. Registry's yours, Captain. We hauled her in to cut her up. Look at her now.

lines.text: Abort the departure. Pull back, Captain. I'll get Morrow recovered. The deal stands; we'll have to try the road again.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [disappointed, steady] Abort the departure. Pull back, Captain. I'll get Morrow recovered. The deal stands; we'll have to try the road again.

lines.text: There's not enough of your company left to cover her. Break off. I'll get her recovered. The deal stands.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] There's not enough of your company left to cover her. Break off. I'll get her recovered. The deal stands.

lines.text: Morrow's out of builders. We can't finish the road with this wing. Break off; we'll recover her and fit another.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [frustrated] Morrow's out of builders. We can't finish the road with this wing. Break off; we'll recover her and fit another.

lines.text: Watch the south haul approach while the builders work at the bend, Captain.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Watch the south haul approach while the builders work at the bend, Captain.

lines.text: Keep someone on the quarry road while you clear the narrows. That's where the new crew came down.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [watchful] Keep someone on the quarry road while you clear the narrows. That's where the new crew came down.

lines.text: Don't leave the pump road open behind you, Captain. We still need that position.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Don't leave the pump road open behind you, Captain. We still need that position.

lines.text: Hold the last approach. Morrow needs that yard clear until she's away.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] Hold the last approach. Morrow needs that yard clear until she's away.

lines.text: My haulers are loaded and going nowhere. The roaches have dug in on the outer road, and two nights ago another crew's boat came down at the quarry.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [tired, frustrated] My haulers are loaded and going nowhere. The roaches have dug in on the outer road, and two nights ago another crew's boat came down at the quarry.

lines.text: So they're waiting for your shipment to move.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured] So they're waiting for your shipment to move.

lines.text: They're waiting for it to move without you beside it. I need the road opened to the eastern yard, with positions along it my militia can hold after you've gone.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [grim] They're waiting for it to move without you beside it. I need the road opened to the eastern yard, with positions along it my militia can hold after you've gone.

lines.text: Positions built by what?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious] Positions built by what?

lines.text: By Morrow. Teo and the fitters have her lift working. She'll hover. She can crawl the road behind you and put her builders down wherever you've cleared.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical] By Morrow. Teo and the fitters have her lift working. She'll hover. She can crawl the road behind you and put her builders down wherever you've cleared.

lines.text: That's a bigger job than the yard. What does it pay?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] That's a bigger job than the yard. What does it pay?

lines.text: A share when the shipment sells.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [careful] A share when the shipment sells.

lines.text: When it sells. To a buyer we don't know, for cargo you won't describe, out past a crew that's already shown it'll kill for it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [skeptical, pointed] When it sells. To a buyer we don't know, for cargo you won't describe, out past a crew that's already shown it'll kill for it.

lines.text: You've had every credit I owed you, on time. Wayline hasn't, so you can guess who I paid first.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [stung, proud] You've had every credit I owed you, on time. Wayline hasn't, so you can guess who I paid first.

lines.text: We have, and I'd like it to stay that way. Our payroll doesn't wait on your buyer.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [acknowledging, firm] We have, and I'd like it to stay that way. Our payroll doesn't wait on your buyer.

lines.text: Then what do you want?
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [impatient] Then what do you want?

lines.text: Morrow.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [simple, steady] Morrow.

lines.text: No.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [flat refusal] No.

lines.text: She's the best thing in this yard that isn't in the Colossus. Her bay was meant to carry this camp through the season, and now she flies, she's worth three times that.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [heated, protective] She's the best thing in this yard that isn't in the Colossus. Her bay was meant to carry this camp through the season, and now she flies, she's worth three times that.

lines.text: Who are you going to sell her to?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [calm] Who are you going to sell her to?

lines.text: That's my business.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [curt] That's my business.

lines.text: Whoever buys a flying Shepherd has to register her at a Hegemony port. Somebody asks where she came from. Then somebody asks what else came down in this valley.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, deliberate] Whoever buys a flying Shepherd has to register her at a Hegemony port. Somebody asks where she came from. Then somebody asks what else came down in this valley.

lines.text: Is that a threat?
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [cold, wary] Is that a threat?

lines.text: It's a reason. We've no interest in telling anyone anything. A mercenary company coming out of a wreck field with a recovered hull is nobody's news. It's how we got our first ship.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [even, reassuring] It's a reason. We've no interest in telling anyone anything. A mercenary company coming out of a wreck field with a recovered hull is nobody's news. It's how we got our first ship.

lines.text: Take her for the job, then. Bring her back when the road's done, and I'll pay you out of the shipment on top.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [bargaining] Take her for the job, then. Bring her back when the road's done, and I'll pay you out of the shipment on top.

lines.text: That's the same promise with a ship attached.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [dry] That's the same promise with a ship attached.

lines.text: Then hear mine. You get the hull and nothing else. Every spare we've already pulled off her stays here. The guns she builds stay here. Not a credit for the road, and not a bolt out of the Colossus.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [hard, conceding] Then hear mine. You get the hull and nothing else. Every spare we've already pulled off her stays here. The guns she builds stay here. Not a credit for the road, and not a bolt out of the Colossus.

lines.text: Agreed.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [immediate] Agreed.

lines.text: And she's not yours until the road's handed to my militia and she's clear of this basin. You don't lift while my people are still walking into position.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm] And she's not yours until the road's handed to my militia and she's clear of this basin. You don't lift while my people are still walking into position.

lines.text: They'll have cover all the way up. We hand over each position before we move on. Who's flying her?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [steady] They'll have cover all the way up. We hand over each position before we move on. Who's flying her?

lines.text: Your own people. Nobody from Basin goes with her. Not Teo, not anyone.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [sharp, protective] Your own people. Nobody from Basin goes with her. Not Teo, not anyone.

lines.text: I wasn't going to ask.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [light, honest] I wasn't going to ask.

lines.text: Good. Teo will walk your crew through her before the drive test. Then he comes home.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [softening slightly] Good. Teo will walk your crew through her before the drive test. Then he comes home.

lines.text: We'll put a crew across from Second Wind. Both ships will be running thin until we can hire. Send the terms and I'll put it to the Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [practical] We'll put a crew across from Second Wind. Both ships will be running thin until we can hire. Send the terms and I'll put it to the Captain.

lines.text: I'll send them. Get her out in one piece, Castle. I've watched enough ships come down in this valley.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, weary] I'll send them. Get her out in one piece, Castle. I've watched enough ships come down in this valley.

lines.text: Morrow's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use Build Vulcan Turret on ground her builders can reach, then do the same at the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off and we'll recover her. The deal stands either way.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [focused, practical] Morrow's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use Build Vulcan Turret on ground her builders can reach, then do the same at the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off and we'll recover her. The deal stands either way.

lines.text: Your company can't cover the work any longer. Break off. We'll pick up from whatever's finished.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] Your company can't cover the work any longer. Break off. We'll pick up from whatever's finished.

lines.text: No builders left to finish the gun. Break off, Captain. The delivery and the power work will keep.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [frustrated] No builders left to finish the gun. Break off, Captain. The delivery and the power work will keep.

lines.text: Wayline's finally dropped the distribution rig on the receiving apron. My fitters take it to the workshop, bring the pump station back and put shore power into the yard. You keep them breathing while they do it. Then you're done.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [brisk, businesslike] Wayline's finally dropped the distribution rig on the receiving apron. My fitters take it to the workshop, bring the pump station back and put shore power into the yard. You keep them breathing while they do it. Then you're done.

lines.text: And the roads?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [neutral] And the roads?

lines.text: Checkpoints on the south haul and the quarry road, manned by day hands from the camps down the valley. My own militia hold the inner line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [confident] Checkpoints on the south haul and the quarry road, manned by day hands from the camps down the valley. My own militia hold the inner line.

lines.text: Day hands.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [flat, skeptical] Day hands.

lines.text: Armed, paid, and a third of what you cost.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [a little defensive] Armed, paid, and a third of what you cost.

lines.text: Harlan's crew took this yard off your own people. They'll know what a checkpoint is worth.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured, pointed] Harlan's crew took this yard off your own people. They'll know what a checkpoint is worth.

lines.text: Harlan's past the quarry. Jory's watched for three days and they haven't come near.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [dismissive] Harlan's past the quarry. Jory's watched for three days and they haven't come near.

lines.text: Your techs said Harlan's crew were trying to wake Morrow's bay. Did anyone ask why?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious, probing] Your techs said Harlan's crew were trying to wake Morrow's bay. Did anyone ask why?

lines.text: Teo thinks her builders could put guns up round the yard. Maybe they could. That bay's the most saleable thing I own outside the Colossus, and every hour those drones work is wear on it. I'm not burning it on guns I don't need.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [reluctant, firm] Teo thinks her builders could put guns up round the yard. Maybe they could. That bay's the most saleable thing I own outside the Colossus, and every hour those drones work is wear on it. I'm not burning it on guns I don't need.

lines.text: Your yard. Captain, we cover the rig and the pump, and when the lights come on we lift.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [cool, letting it go] Your yard. Captain, we cover the rig and the pump, and when the lights come on we lift.

lines.text: Keep fire off my fitters. And if those checkpoints call for help, they're on my payroll. Cover them back to the inner line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical, a touch of conscience] Keep fire off my fitters. And if those checkpoints call for help, they're on my payroll. Cover them back to the inner line.

lines.text: Captain, last job on Asharu. Get the rig to the workshop, then cover Vale's fitters at the pump. When the lights come on, we lift.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [composed, businesslike] Captain, last job on Asharu. Get the rig to the workshop, then cover Vale's fitters at the pump. When the lights come on, we lift.

lines.text: The rig's on the apron, Captain. Stay with it along the workshop road. I paid for every bolt of it.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [protective] The rig's on the apron, Captain. Stay with it along the workshop road. I paid for every bolt of it.

lines.text: Rig's at the workshop. Now clear the pump station for my fitters. They need to reconnect shore power.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [brisk] Rig's at the workshop. Now clear the pump station for my fitters. They need to reconnect shore power.

lines.text: They're on the pump connection. Keep that ground covered until they're done.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [focused] They're on the pump connection. Keep that ground covered until they're done.

lines.text: Shore power's on, and Teo says Morrow's bay is answering. Damn the buyer. Select Build Vulcan Turret and put a road gun on clear ground within reach of her bay.

Clear the pump bend and the narrows, cover the building, then hand the positions over. Stay with her through the drive test. When the road's ours and she's clear of the basin, she's yours.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [steady, determined] We still have a deal, Castle. Teo needs time on her drives before we try again. I'll see to it, and I'll send fresh holders. Clear the pump bend and the narrows, cover the building, then hand the positions over. Stay with her through the drive test. When the road's ours and she's clear of the basin, she's yours.

lines.text: Payment's received. Why would a salvage crew want a wrecked drone tender awake?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious] Payment's received. Why would a salvage crew want a wrecked drone tender awake?

lines.text: Same reason anyone wants builders on a yard they mean to keep, I'd guess. Doesn't matter now. The bay's still in her, and she's still mine.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [dismissive, possessive] Same reason anyone wants builders on a yard they mean to keep, I'd guess. Doesn't matter now. The bay's still in her, and she's still mine.

lines.text: They won't have gone far.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [cautious] They won't have gone far.

lines.text: Past the quarry, Jory says, and still going. I've got my yard back and no power to work it. The heavy machinery to fix that is still in Wayline's shed, and they stripped the pump station. Mara can deliver now there's a yard to deliver to. One more contract: cover my fitters while we get the lights on.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical] Past the quarry, Jory says, and still going. I've got my yard back and no power to work it. The heavy machinery to fix that is still in Wayline's shed, and they stripped the pump station. Mara can deliver now there's a yard to deliver to. One more contract: cover my fitters while we get the lights on.

lines.text: One more?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [catching it] One more?

lines.text: After that I've got guards coming for the roads. Nothing personal, Castle. You're good, and you're not cheap.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [blunt, not unkind] After that I've got guards coming for the roads. Nothing personal, Castle. You're good, and you're not cheap.

lines.text: We'll get the company ready. Keep your fitters together until we're there to cover them.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [professional] We'll get the company ready. Keep your fitters together until we're there to cover them.

lines.text: You lost people at that cradle. We'll put ours in order before we take another crew out there.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [sober, considerate] You lost people at that cradle. We'll put ours in order before we take another crew out there.

lines.text: Do. The rig will be on the receiving apron. Come to me when you're ready.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [brief] Do. The rig will be on the receiving apron. Come to me when you're ready.

lines.text: Captain, did you see how fast those builders put that gun up? Off a wreck we found in pieces.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [impressed] Captain, did you see how fast those builders put that gun up? Off a wreck we found in pieces.

lines.text: I saw. Teo had her bay talking before the lights were steady. A Shepherd with a working bay is worth three of her in pieces, so don't look at her like that, Castle. Your fee's sent.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [wry, guarded] I saw. Teo had her bay talking before the lights were steady. A Shepherd with a working bay is worth three of her in pieces, so don't look at her like that, Castle. Your fee's sent.

lines.text: And your checkpoints?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [neutral, not gloating] And your checkpoints?

lines.text: Paid off. Most of them have gone home, and I can't say I blame them. Harlan's back on the outer road, and Jory says he's had company since. Finish up with your people, then come and see me. Seems I'm not done with you after all.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [rueful] Paid off. Most of them have gone home, and I can't say I blame them. Harlan's back on the outer road, and Jory says he's had company since. Finish up with your people, then come and see me. Seems I'm not done with you after all.

lines.text: We'll need time before we take on anything else. We've people to account for.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [sober] We'll need time before we take on anything else. We've people to account for.

lines.text: So do I. Take it. The outer road's still shut, and I won't talk about that over the radio. Come and see me when you can.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, tired] So do I. Take it. The outer road's still shut, and I won't talk about that over the radio. Come and see me when you can.

lines.text: Registry confirms it, Captain. Morrow's ours. She's flying on a skeleton crew off Second Wind, and Second Wind's not much better off. We'll need to hire before we ask much of either of them.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [satisfied, practical] Registry confirms it, Captain. Morrow's ours. She's flying on a skeleton crew off Second Wind, and Second Wind's not much better off. We'll need to hire before we ask much of either of them.

lines.text: Have your crew check her drone-bay filters first. Basin dust gets into everything.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical, a little fond] Have your crew check her drone-bay filters first. Basin dust gets into everything.

lines.text: Any chance of hands from the camp?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [hopeful] Any chance of hands from the camp?

lines.text: Try the port at Jangala. Nobody in this valley's leaving it for you.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [dry, final] Try the port at Jangala. Nobody in this valley's leaving it for you.

lines.text: Jory's crew can walk out of the Colossus tonight. Safe passage, Castle.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [warm, relieved] Jory's crew can walk out of the Colossus tonight. Safe passage, Castle.

lines.text: I know what it cost your people to get her out. I'll leave you to them. Safe passage, Castle.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [gentle] I know what it cost your people to get her out. I'll leave you to them. Safe passage, Castle.

lines.text: I'd better go. There are families waiting on a call from me, and some of them are mine. Look after her, Castle.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [heavy, quiet] I'd better go. There are families waiting on a call from me, and some of them are mine. Look after her, Castle.

lines.text: Saltwell Cross, Captain. It's a dust-road trading post on Asharu, where the crawler road from the salvage claims meets the road to the public freight apron. The broker who trades in our sailing times works there: Oskar Teague, out of the old pump house at the east edge of town. He sells them to a pirate crew called Sable Wake.
lines.synthesisText: Saltwell Cross, Captain. It's a dust-road trading post on Asharu, where the crawler road from the salvage claims meets the road to the public freight apron. The broker who trades in our sailing times works there: Oskar Teague, out of the old pump house at the east edge of town. He sells them to a pirate crew called Sable Wake.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Asharu is not ours and not the pirates'. Who comes down on us when the shooting starts?
lines.synthesisText: Asharu is not ours and not the pirates'. Who comes down on us when the shooting starts?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Nobody in particular. The Hegemony claims the world and keeps no administration on it; its patrols turn up to chase pirates or collect tariffs. Wayline lands freight at Saltwell Cross on a schedule, so we come down as the scheduled drop, on the public apron, lawfully.
lines.synthesisText: Nobody in particular. The Hegemony claims the world and keeps no administration on it; its patrols turn up to chase pirates or collect tariffs. Wayline lands freight at Saltwell Cross on a schedule, so we come down as the scheduled drop, on the public apron, lawfully.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: And the target is a pirate crew, the one thing the only patrols out here exist to chase. The Hegemony would thank us, if it noticed.
lines.synthesisText: And the target is a pirate crew, the one thing the only patrols out here exist to chase. The Hegemony would thank us, if it noticed.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: The town has a market warden, Tobias Ankrum. He speaks for Saltwell Cross, not for Asharu and not for any faction. I bought his indifference with a season of freight credit. His price is that the fight stays at the pump house and the market is not touched.
lines.synthesisText: The town has a market warden, Tobias Ankrum. He speaks for Saltwell Cross, not for Asharu and not for any faction. I bought his indifference with a season of freight credit. His price is that the fight stays at the pump house and the market is not touched.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Then the market is off the table. Not a round into it, not a stall knocked over. We walk in as freight, not as a raid.
lines.synthesisText: Then the market is off the table. Not a round into it, not a stall knocked over. We walk in as freight, not as a raid.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Teague keeps a skimmer on a pad past the southern canal crossing, and his lift-off is on a schedule. Let it run out and he leaves, and he radios the alarm on his way up. If you take him alive, he can name every buyer he ever sold our dates to.
lines.synthesisText: Teague keeps a skimmer on a pad past the southern canal crossing, and his lift-off is on a schedule. Let it run out and he leaves, and he radios the alarm on his way up. If you take him alive, he can name every buyer he ever sold our dates to.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: The quiet is the resource, Captain, and it spends. A shot fired, or one of us seen by a sentry inside the compound ring, and clerks start feeding the ledger to a burn barrel. Seize the ledger room and the burn stops.
lines.synthesisText: The quiet is the resource, Captain, and it spends. A shot fired, or one of us seen by a sentry inside the compound ring, and clerks start feeding the ledger to a burn barrel. Seize the ledger room and the burn stops.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: One thing more. The compound has gun nests and manned pillboxes on its entrances. The nests run off an illegal tap on the town's old power line; our manifests show the generator parts going in. The junction box stands outside the ring, between the Harrow lane and the postern.
lines.synthesisText: One thing more. The compound has gun nests and manned pillboxes on its entrances. The nests run off an illegal tap on the town's old power line; our manifests show the generator parts going in. The junction box stands outside the ring, between the Harrow lane and the postern.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Cut the feed before the shooting and the nests are dark. After it starts, rockets or the Hound answer them. The pillboxes are manned, so those we take by hand.
lines.synthesisText: Cut the feed before the shooting and the nests are dark. After it starts, rockets or the Hound answer them. The pillboxes are manned, so those we take by hand.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: There are two more favours you can do before that, both outside the ring. Anneke Harrow's crew is stranded in their yard on the crawler road waiting on a drive coupling that is in this drop. Carry it to them and they will be on the crawler road when it starts. Or stand at the warden's well house a while and let Ankrum's watch see you pay your respects: they will hold the cantina and put spotters on the rooftops.
lines.synthesisText: There are two more favours you can do before that, both outside the ring. Anneke Harrow's crew is stranded in their yard on the crawler road waiting on a drive coupling that is in this drop. Carry it to them and they will be on the crawler road when it starts. Or stand at the warden's well house a while and let Ankrum's watch see you pay your respects: they will hold the cantina and put spotters on the rooftops.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: All three cost clock, not exposure. How much of Teague's time you spend on them is your call.
lines.synthesisText: All three cost clock, not exposure. How much of Teague's time you spend on them is your call.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: I want the ledger whole, but I'll take what's left. Even a burned ledger leaves the strongbox, and the strongbox is where the signature will be. Bring the records to the freight apron, and Teague with them if you've got him.
lines.synthesisText: I want the ledger whole, but I'll take what's left. Even a burned ledger leaves the strongbox, and the strongbox is where the signature will be. Bring the records to the freight apron, and Teague with them if you've got him.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Records and the broker to the apron. Every surviving squad aboard. Mind the market, Captain.
lines.synthesisText: Records and the broker to the apron. Every surviving squad aboard. Mind the market, Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: That crate is Harrow's drive coupling. Their yard is up the crawler road, past the market. Anneke Harrow has been sitting on a dead crawler for nine days, and she has been very civil about it.
lines.synthesisText: That crate is Harrow's drive coupling. Their yard is up the crawler road, past the market. Anneke Harrow has been sitting on a dead crawler for nine days, and she has been very civil about it.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Harrow has the coupling in and the crawler is turning over. Anneke says her crew will be on the crawler road when it starts, and that this isn't charity, it's an account settled.
lines.synthesisText: Harrow has the coupling in and the crawler is turning over. Anneke says her crew will be on the crawler road when it starts, and that this isn't charity, it's an account settled.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: That's the well house. Ankrum's the one on the step with the ledger under his arm. Take your time, Captain; we're here to be seen paying respects.
lines.synthesisText: That's the well house. Ankrum's the one on the step with the ledger under his arm. Take your time, Captain; we're here to be seen paying respects.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Ankrum has nodded. His watch will hold the cantina, and there are watchmen on two market rooftops who'll tell you what they see in the compound yard. That is all he's selling, and it is more than I hoped.
lines.synthesisText: Ankrum has nodded. His watch will hold the cantina, and there are watchmen on two market rooftops who'll tell you what they see in the compound yard. That is all he's selling, and it is more than I hoped.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Captain, Teague's lift-off is close. If you want him, the time to decide is now.
lines.synthesisText: Captain, Teague's lift-off is close. If you want him, the time to decide is now.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Shots fired. The quiet is over. Civilians are running, so mind your fire.
lines.synthesisText: Shots fired. The quiet is over. Civilians are running, so mind your fire.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: A sentry has us inside the ring. Compound is waking up. Go loud and go fast.
lines.synthesisText: A sentry has us inside the ring. Compound is waking up. Go loud and go fast.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Teague's skimmer is up. He's calling it in on his way out. The alarm's on you now, Captain.
lines.synthesisText: Teague's skimmer is up. He's calling it in on his way out. The alarm's on you now, Captain.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Cantina's emptying. Pirates, a handful of them, heading for the compound with their jackets over their guns.
lines.synthesisText: Cantina's emptying. Pirates, a handful of them, heading for the compound with their jackets over their guns.
lines.speaker: SABINE HALE / SECTION LEAD

lines.text: Cantina's quiet. The watch has the door and nobody's coming out of it.
lines.synthesisText: Cantina's quiet. The watch has the door and nobody's coming out of it.
lines.speaker: SABINE HALE / SECTION LEAD

lines.text: The barrel's lit. They're feeding the books to it a shelf at a time. Seize that ledger room before there's nothing left to seize.
lines.synthesisText: The barrel's lit. They're feeding the books to it a shelf at a time. Seize that ledger room before there's nothing left to seize.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Half the books are ash, Captain. Whatever's left, take it.
lines.synthesisText: Half the books are ash, Captain. Whatever's left, take it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Ledger room is ours. The burn is stopped. Get what survives to the apron.
lines.synthesisText: Ledger room is ours. The burn is stopped. Get what survives to the apron.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: The books are gone. Smoke, nothing else. The strongbox is still in the pump house, and the strongbox is what I need now.
lines.synthesisText: The books are gone. Smoke, nothing else. The strongbox is still in the pump house, and the strongbox is what I need now.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Harrow's crew is coming down the crawler road. Four of them with rifles, heading for the east gate. They won't last long on their own, so keep the gate busy.
lines.synthesisText: Harrow's crew is coming down the crawler road. Four of them with rifles, heading for the east gate. They won't last long on their own, so keep the gate busy.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Rooftop watchmen have the compound yard. Marking sentries and the barrel now.
lines.synthesisText: Rooftop watchmen have the compound yard. Marking sentries and the barrel now.
lines.speaker: SABINE HALE / SECTION LEAD

lines.text: Teague's out of his office and running for the skimmer pad, south past the canal crossing. Cut him off if you can.
lines.synthesisText: Teague's out of his office and running for the skimmer pad, south past the canal crossing. Cut him off if you can.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Teague's hands are up. He'll walk with us. Somebody get him to the apron before his friends find him.
lines.synthesisText: Teague's hands are up. He'll walk with us. Somebody get him to the apron before his friends find him.
lines.speaker: SABINE HALE / SECTION LEAD

lines.text: We've lost Teague. Whatever he knew has gone with him.
lines.synthesisText: We've lost Teague. Whatever he knew has gone with him.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: The skimmer's off the pad with Teague aboard. That's gone, Captain. Take the records and go.
lines.synthesisText: The skimmer's off the pad with Teague aboard. That's gone, Captain. Take the records and go.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Teague is at the apron, alive. Keep him that way until he's aboard.
lines.synthesisText: Teague is at the apron, alive. Keep him that way until he's aboard.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: That's the junction box. Work it quietly and without a break, Captain. If we're pulled off it halfway, the tap stays live.
lines.synthesisText: That's the junction box. Work it quietly and without a break, Captain. If we're pulled off it halfway, the tap stays live.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: The tap's cut. Whatever Sable Wake has pointed at that road is running on batteries and prayer now. Nobody in town will miss it.
lines.synthesisText: The tap's cut. Whatever Sable Wake has pointed at that road is running on batteries and prayer now. Nobody in town will miss it.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Gun nests are dark. Their feed stayed cut. Move while they're blind.
lines.synthesisText: Gun nests are dark. Their feed stayed cut. Move while they're blind.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Nests are live. The tap was never cut, and they have the yard covered. Stay off open ground, or bring rockets to bear.
lines.synthesisText: Nests are live. The tap was never cut, and they have the yard covered. Stay off open ground, or bring rockets to bear.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Nest is down. One fewer gun on that approach. Keep moving.
lines.synthesisText: Nest is down. One fewer gun on that approach. Keep moving.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Pillbox, firing from the slits. They have cover and we don't. Don't trade rounds with it from the open; go round or put something heavy through the slit.
lines.synthesisText: Pillbox, firing from the slits. They have cover and we don't. Don't trade rounds with it from the open; go round or put something heavy through the slit.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: The ledger room was ours before the barrel did more than smoke. Every book is in the crates, Mara.
lines.synthesisText: The ledger room was ours before the barrel did more than smoke. Every book is in the crates, Mara.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: We took the room with the barrel half fed. Half the books are ash, half are in the crates.
lines.synthesisText: We took the room with the barrel half fed. Half the books are ash, half are in the crates.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: They fed the barrel faster than we could cross the yard, and the books are ash. We got the strongbox out of the pump house.
lines.synthesisText: They fed the barrel faster than we could cross the yard, and the books are ash. We got the strongbox out of the pump house.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Teague talked before the kettle boiled, and the books agree with him. Every sailing Sable Wake bought is there, Wayline's own schedules, released under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, the last batch dated the week he left. The routing points to a listening post on Warion. I built half of those schedules beside him. I can't tell you why he would sell them.
lines.synthesisText: Teague talked before the kettle boiled, and the books agree with him. Every sailing Sable Wake bought is there, Wayline's own schedules, released under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, the last batch dated the week he left. The routing points to a listening post on Warion. I built half of those schedules beside him. I can't tell you why he would sell them.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Teague is gone, but the books he couldn't burn tell it without him. Wayline's own schedules, released under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, the last batch dated the week he left. The routing points to a listening post on Warion. He built Wayline. I don't know who he sold it for.

Wayline's own schedules, released under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, the last batch dated the week he left. The routing points to a listening post on Warion. He built Wayline. I don't know who he sold it for.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: The books are scorched and half gone, but Teague filled the gaps and the pages that remain agree with him. Our schedules went out under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, the last of them the week he left. The routing ends at a listening post on Warion. I don't understand it, and he can't tell me why.
lines.synthesisText: The books are scorched and half gone, but Teague filled the gaps and the pages that remain agree with him. Our schedules went out under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, the last of them the week he left. The routing ends at a listening post on Warion. I don't understand it, and he can't tell me why.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Half a ledger and no broker. What survived still carries Teodor Prell's dispatch authority on our schedules, the last batch dated the week he left, and the routing that remains names a listening post on Warion. It's enough to act on. It isn't enough to understand.
lines.synthesisText: Half a ledger and no broker. What survived still carries Teodor Prell's dispatch authority on our schedules, the last batch dated the week he left, and the routing that remains names a listening post on Warion. It's enough to act on. It isn't enough to understand.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: The books are ash, but the strongbox wasn't, and Teague has the rest in his head. One page carries Teodor Prell's dispatch authority over our schedules, dated the week he left. Teague says the calls went to a listening post on Warion. He doesn't know why Prell did it either.
lines.synthesisText: The books are ash, but the strongbox wasn't, and Teague has the rest in his head. One page carries Teodor Prell's dispatch authority over our schedules, dated the week he left. Teague says the calls went to a listening post on Warion. He doesn't know why Prell did it either.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Ash, and Teague in the wind. The strongbox gave us one page, but it is the right one: our schedules released under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, dated the week he left, and a listening post on Warion at the end of the route. I will take that and be glad of it.
lines.synthesisText: Ash, and Teague in the wind. The strongbox gave us one page, but it is the right one: our schedules released under Teodor Prell's dispatch authority, dated the week he left, and a listening post on Warion at the end of the route. I will take that and be glad of it.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Teague is in the hold in one piece, and Ankrum's market came through untouched. That credit was well spent. Put the company in order. When you are ready, we take Warion's ears away.
lines.synthesisText: Teague is in the hold in one piece, and Ankrum's market came through untouched. That credit was well spent. Put the company in order. When you are ready, we take Warion's ears away.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Teague is out there with his own copy of the numbers. Sable Wake will know we came down as freight. Better to reach Warion before they close their ears. Account for your people first, Captain.
lines.synthesisText: Teague is out there with his own copy of the numbers. Sable Wake will know we came down as freight. Better to reach Warion before they close their ears. Account for your people first, Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
